skills._comment_mcp_config: Optional. Path (relative to VAULT_ROOT) to an MCP config JSON loaded ONLY for invocations this skill matches. Bridge sessions run with --strict-mcp-config, so MCP servers are off by default; set this if the skill genuinely needs one, e.g. an HA server. Omit to keep MCP fully disabled.
